 Micho ahead of RBLFCA: "We need to switch our focus back to the Bundesliga" 
 Go to the comments section Add to your bookmarks Share this article RB Leipzig are looking ahead to welcoming their next opponent to the Red Bull Arena, with FC Augsburg in town on Saturday afternoon (15:30 CET) . The Red Bulls will be aiming to equal a Bundesliga record against Augsburg
 Ahead of the game, head coach Martín Demichelis spoke to the media about which players are unavailable and how his side will approach the game. Read on for all the key quotes from today's pre-match press conference.
 OneFootball Videos
 Possible rotation
 "It's normal that our players might still feel a bit tired two days after the City game. It demanded a lot from us . This is our fourth straight week with a mid-week fixture . We will wait until tomorrow to decide who will be able to start." 
 The opponent
 "They are a tough side to play against. They have completed the second-most sprints in the league. At the very least, we need to match their intensity, energy and willingness to run hard , while also using our quality to try and pick up three points. Augsburg had an entire week to prepare themselves for this match. Our fixture schedule is brutal, but the team have been able to show a different face in our recent games and have taken a step forward in their development." 
 The approach
 "We need to switch our focus back to the Bundesliga . We want to win in order to close the gap to first place to no more than three points. The team are in good form. I'm confident that we will be able to put in a strong performance, despite the tiredness in our legs." 
 A milestone for Willi Orbán
 " Willi does so much for the team. He's a model professional in all areas, from how he recovers and fuels himself, to how strong he is. He's always faced internal competition over the last years, but has always played – that's no coincidence . 
 The young players can learn a lot from him. I'm very happy for him and it's an honour to work with him . He's always in a good mood and always ready." 
 The upcoming international break
 " We've planned to have Sunday off. We're also looking to plan a friendly for Thursday. Unlike the last international break, we'll have more players staying here and fewer injuries. The risks associated with a friendly were too high last time, but now it's a different story. It will be good for several of the players. 
 The break will be shorter this time around and I'm planning on staying here. There is a lot to do. The players will need some time to rest, however."
